The '''Tourani system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located within the [[Yucrales sector/Legends|Yucrales sector]], a part of the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] regions known as the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]<ref name="EAOC" /> and [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]].<ref name="TEA" /> It was the origin point of the items known as [[Touranian jumping-stone]]s.<ref name="Mindor">''[[Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor]]''</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=[[Touranian jumping-stone]]s|system=Tourani [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Tourani system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square R-15.<ref name="TEA" />
